lines.text: Role: Fighters excel at combat—defeating their enemies, controlling the flow of battle, and surviving such sorties themselves. While their specific weapons and methods grant them a wide variety of tactics, few can match fighters for sheer battle prowess.

The fighter's class skills are Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Handle Animal (Cha), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (dungeoneering) (Int), Knowledge (engineering) (Int), Profession (Wis), Ride (Dex), Survival (Wis), and Swim (Str).
20th+20/+15/+10/+5+12+6+6Bonus feat, weapon mastery
Weapon and Armor Proficiency: A fighter is proficient with all simple and martial weapons and with all armor (heavy, light, and medium) and shields (including tower shields).

description.value:
Role: Fighters excel at combat—defeating their enemies, controlling the flow of battle, and surviving such sorties themselves. While their specific weapons and methods grant them a wide variety of tactics, few can match fighters for sheer battle prowess.

Class Skills

The fighter’s class skills are Climb (Str), Craft (Int), Handle Animal (Cha), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (dungeoneering) (Int), Knowledge (engineering) (Int), Profession (Wis), Ride (Dex), Survival (Wis), and Swim (Str).

candidates.rationale: Complete CRB class (pp. 55-56) compared with the PRD capture (coreRulebook/classes/fighter.html): d10 (:350), the ten class skills (:352), 2 + Int skill ranks (:353) and Table: Fighter (:356-376: full base attack bonus, good Fortitude, poor Reflex and Will), matching the imported hitDie 10, bab full, saves fort good / ref poor / will poor, skillRanksPerLevel 2 and classSkills; PCGen's Core Rulebook rows agree (cr_classes.lst:139 HD:10 and BAB/save formulas, :141 two skill points, cr_abilities_class.lst:2835 Class Skills ~ Fighter). S3's reviewed schedule gives 27 featuresByLevel rows, each checked against the table: 11 bonus feats (1st and every even level), Bravery 2/6/10/14/18, Armor Training 3/7/11/15, Weapon Training 5/9/13/17, Heavy Armor at 7 (a kept Foundry non-row), Armor Mastery at 19 and Weapon Mastery at 20. Foundry's class skills add Artistry and Lore, Pathfinder Unchained background skills (PCGen pu_skills.lst:86-87), kept as prose, so PZO1131 is required beside PZO1110; both are reviewed. Weapon and armor proficiencies (:379) stay in gameContent: an outstanding calculation. The binding covers the whole 28-body closure, Bravery's Note included. The Fighter is dependently omitted while Weapon Training (#625) and its 9/13/17 increments stay held on owner-owed evidence; it admits with no re-review once that assessment is confirmed and its body is unchanged.
